F1.evidence: personalPublisher (src/claws/draft-publish.ts:19) takes the token from resolveClawHubAuthToken, which reads the host's CLAWHUB_TOKEN env var or saved login (src/infra/clawhub-client.ts:161-183). Nothing ties that token to the caller. Seeing this needs a second eligible admin on a shared Gateway, and review does show the publisher handle.

F2.evidence: readClawDraft decodes with a default TextDecoder, which strips a BOM, and then hashes the decoded string (src/claws/draft.ts:66-67). updateWorkspaceFile compares the expected hash against sha256Hex of the raw buffer, BOM included (src/gateway/server-methods/workspace-fs.ts:282-284), so every save of such a file conflicts.

F3.evidence: src/claws/draft-choices.ts:96-100 sets manifest.agent.name = choices?.name ?? proposal.name, the lowercase slug, unconditionally. That overwrites the 'Portable Agent' display name shown in skills/create-claw/references/draft-format.md.

F4.evidence: createClawDraft seeds description: "" (src/claws/draft.ts:42). At src/claws/draft-choices.ts:97-101, ?? stops at "", and description || undefined then clears manifest.agent.description. Review shows the empty field, so the creator can fill it in.

F5.evidence: draft-choices.ts:102-104 removes the excluded workspace.files entry but leaves agent.identity.avatar in place. The manifest schema then rejects a workspace-relative avatar that matches no workspace.files destination (src/claws/schema.ts:589-598), so the build fails for that selection.

F6.evidence: Plugin review items come only from manifest.packages (src/claws/draft-choices.ts:67-74). Profile extensions are still planned and installed as plugins (src/claws/application-plan.ts:132-215, lifecycle.ts:503). A plugin declared only in profiles/openclaw.yml therefore gets no checkbox.

F7.evidence: draftAuthority creates the draft under resolveAgentWorkspaceDir(cfg, agentId) (src/gateway/server-methods/claws-drafts.ts:39). The prompt passes only the relative .openclaw/claw-drafts path (src/claws/draft-prompt.ts). Runs in a session with spawnedWorkspaceDir use that directory as their workspace (src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run-context.ts:348).

F8.evidence: The bare catch at src/claws/draft-publish.ts:124-129 replaces every error from fetchClawHubJson, including a ClawHubRequestError that carries the HTTP status and body (src/infra/clawhub-client.ts:358-359), with a generic publication_unconfirmed message.

F9.evidence: A whoami failure throws a non-ClawProjectError from fetchClawHubJson (src/claws/draft-publish.ts:28; clawhub-client.ts:358-359). draftError then returns 'could not be processed. Check its contents' (src/gateway/server-methods/claws-drafts.ts:89-94).

F10.evidence: Excluding profiles/openclaw.yml drops the file (draft-choices.ts:124-127) but leaves metadata openclaw.config in place. readClawOpenClawProfile then follows that pointer when the conventional file is missing and returns openclaw_profile_read_failed (src/claws/openclaw-profile.ts:126-200). Hitting this needs the deprecated pointer in a newly written draft.

F11.evidence: assertCurrent requires only hasCurrentPersonalGatewaySource plus the operator.admin scope (src/gateway/server-methods/claws-drafts.ts:42-44). It never checks the client mode, and the method descriptors carry only operator.admin (core-descriptors.ts), so a registered headless owner socket can review and publish. Such a client already has full operator trust.
